about.heading: We put AI at the core of how IBM Research works — turning the frontier of AI-native research into infrastructure that accelerates every pillar of the portfolio.
paragraphs: Artificial intelligence is remaking what a research organization can do — and computing is where it can move fastest, from the physics of quantum devices to the chips and compilers that power the next era of computation.
AI Industrialization operates across the division to bring AI-native research to the core of the division's biggest bets, building common ground in agents, experimentation, inference, and data.

This work starts with priority workloads: quantum calibration, error correction, and compilation; ASIC chip design; compiler design and kernel synthesis. Each one shortens the path from idea to result and strengthens the platform for the next, directly changing how the division does research.

principles.title: AI at the core
principles.body: We embed with teams across the pillars to re-center priority workloads around AI, accelerating the domains where IBM Research has decades of history.

principles.title: Build once, impact everywhere
principles.body: Agent infrastructure, experiment tooling, serving, telemetry — core capabilities, built once, reach every pillar. Each deployment makes the next one faster.

principles.title: Moving with the frontier
principles.body: We work with researchers across the pillars to push AI itself forward. Lessons from each workload are folded back into the platform, where every team can pick them up.

capabilities.title: Agent infrastructure
capabilities.body: We build and operate shared infrastructure for AI-native research across the portfolio. Agents run continuously in the cloud — each in an isolated sandbox behind a zero-trust credential gateway — driven from the browser, the CLI, Slack, or on schedules. The platform is harness-agnostic, so teams ride the frontier as it moves.

capabilities.title: Inference at scale
capabilities.body: We build the serving substrate that agentic research demands, keeping thousands of concurrent agents supplied with the models they run on. We tune it for the throughput and cost profile of long-running autonomous work, so experiments are bounded by ideas, not capacity.

capabilities.title: Autonomous experimentation
capabilities.body: We turn agentic exploration into instrumented science. Researchers author design–build–test–learn loops as ordinary code, and the platform observes them live — every stage, span, and score — making campaigns on priority workloads, from quantum algorithm discovery to kernel synthesis, repeatable and comparable.

capabilities.title: Operational data
capabilities.body: Running the platform produces a second asset: agent turns, experiment spans, and inference telemetry, collected into an AI-native record of how agents actually solve research problems. That record drives the optimizations that compound — better skills and loops, more efficient serving, and more performant agentic systems with every workload.
